canonical_id: AutoDesign one-component meta-harness optimization with development-set acceptance

source.paper: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design

environment.lockfile: uv.lock is committed and contains hashed locked dependencies

benchmark_identity.posterbench_main: 100 papers across five disciplines according to the paper/dataset release
benchmark_identity.posterbench_mini: shared 10-paper subset according to the paper/dataset release
benchmark_identity.manifest: eval/benchmark_manifest.jsonl is documented as the benchmark single source of truth and stores task/track plus SHA-256 identities for visible prompt/grader files
benchmark_identity.integrity: eval.manifest.verify_manifest is documented as running before benchmark execution/aggregation in normal operation
benchmark_identity.hidden_grader_handling: hidden grader files can be verified by locally installed file hashes or environment-provided SHA pins
benchmark_identity.normalization: evaluation documentation specifies raw per-grader aggregation and normalization against grader maxima rather than summing already-normalized subscores
benchmark_identity.routing: task bundles are routed to one frozen grader path; human-final variants are distinguished from judge-based routes

released_implementation.core_package: autodesign/ contains concrete artifact authoring, candidate assessment, candidate publication, immutable attempt selection/promotion, browser/quality validation and agent tooling
released_implementation.selection_example: autodesign/attempt_selection.py records immutable candidate identity and SHA, rejects blocked candidates, journals promotion state, and ranks nonblocked delivery candidates without trusting author-reported scores
released_implementation.runtime_artifacts: the public .gitignore excludes out/, /output/, sessions/, tmp/, .designanything/, dataset/, internal calibration labels, and other local development state
released_implementation.releases: GitHub releases publish versioned agent-skill ZIP artifacts with SHA-256 digest assets; audited release list includes agent-skills-v0.2.0 published 2026-08-19

paper_claims_traceable_to_primary_source.recursive_optimization: The primary paper describes a meta-harness optimizer using rollout feedback to recursively improve a reusable DesignHarness.
paper_claims_traceable_to_primary_source.one_component_credit_assignment: Primary method description says the optimizer chooses a single highest-leverage harness component per intervention to improve credit assignment.
paper_claims_traceable_to_primary_source.development_gate: Primary method description states proposed harness updates are promoted only when training performance improves without degrading development-set performance.
paper_claims_traceable_to_primary_source.reported_evolution_scale: Author-facing primary material reports seven days, 224 subagents, 123+ recursive iterations and 54 accepted harness updates.
paper_claims_traceable_to_primary_source.reported_transfer: The paper reports learned DesignHarness attachment across seven code-agent/model configurations raising mean PosterBench from 54.99 to 67.39 (+12.4%).
paper_claims_traceable_to_primary_source.reported_main_score: The paper reports PosterBench Main Track 78.32 versus Claude Design 70.87 (+7.45).
paper_claims_traceable_to_primary_source.long_horizon_example: The paper reports 253 tool calls and 11 editing turns within 40 minutes for under $3 in its long-horizon example.

reproducibility_assessment.official_artifact_support: strong for the released design agent, final reusable harness surface, benchmark/evaluation package, task identities, and versioned skill artifacts
reproducibility_assessment.independent_replication: not identified in the targeted public search on 2026-08-25
reproducibility_assessment.judgment: AutoDesign has unusually substantial public implementation and benchmark-reconstruction support for a newly released system: locked dependencies, a hash-addressed benchmark manifest, evaluator integrity checks, concrete agent/candidate machinery, versioned skill releases with digests, and public PosterBench metadata. However, the evidence located in this pass does not make the exact seven-day meta-harness evolution history independently replayable. The public repository exposes the resulting system and evaluation substrate, but the complete 123+ iteration / 54-acceptance raw optimization trajectory, all rollout outputs, and exact historical acceptance ledger were not located as committed public artifacts. The headline gains therefore remain primary-study results rather than independently reproduced results.
exact_blockers: No independent public rerun reproducing the paper's 78.32 PosterBench score, seven-configuration +12.4-point average harness attachment gain, or recursive evolution trajectory was found in the targeted search.

The exact 123+ iteration / 54 accepted-update outer-loop history was found as an author-reported primary claim, but a complete public per-iteration proposal/evaluation/acceptance ledger was not located in the audited repository.
Runtime artifacts are explicitly gitignored (including out/, /output/, sessions/ and tmp/), so the repository commit alone does not preserve all historical generated outputs and rollout traces.

Several evaluation routes depend on model/judge/provider behavior and some hidden-grader material may be locally installed/hash-pinned rather than fully public, leaving residual service/content drift for exact historical reruns.

PosterBench underlying papers have source/license boundaries; the public dataset publishes metadata and expected hashes but some records require lawful manual acquisition, so the full benchmark corpus is not guaranteed to be one-command self-contained.

The released code is broader than the paper's experimental outer loop and contains product/runtime candidate-selection machinery; presence of that machinery must not be conflated with a bit-for-bit release of the paper's historical meta-optimizer trajectory.
reproducibility_assessment.scope: Strong author-side reproducibility for the released framework, benchmark identity/integrity, evaluation pipeline, and final harness artifacts. Partial reproducibility for the exact recursive optimizer history. No independent replication established. Do not infer that individual harness components caused the full +12.4-point gain merely from full-harness attachment, and do not treat the development gate as a proof against adaptive-validation overfit.
